what_happened: Full general-gluing construction (union domain, left-biased dite states, 4-way respects_task split, convexity of the union, both reading equations, both restriction identities, uniqueness via partialHistory_ext, and the packaged ExistsUnique) compiled on the first corrected probe pass with every declaration measuring [propext, Quot.sound] -- choice-free, matching Sheaf.lean's and Ray.lean's profile. Research therefore hands the planner a verified construction, not a sketch.

Lean cannot eliminate the union domain's Prop-valued Or into the WorldState Type, so the glued states function needs a DecidablePred hypothesis on one side's domain; the choice-free pin rmk:choice demands rules out Classical.propDecidable, which would reinstate Classical.choice. This is an encoding hypothesis the paper's statement does not carry and must be recorded explicitly in the docstring as a Lean-constructивity artifact rather than a mathematical choice principle.

Research round left a fully verified, warning-free, choice-free probe (gluing-probe.lean, exit 0 under lake env lean) covering every deliverable. Planning was transcription plus gate sequencing rather than design, so the plan carries no unverified proof step.

Research report states partialHistory_ext has 'all four existing uses'. Re-derived at plan time: 13 call sites across 5 files (Behavior.lean 3, Sheaf.lean 4, Directed.lean 2, Determinism.lean 3, BehSeparatedness.lean 1), plus 2 markdown README mentions. Conclusion (relocation is call-site-neutral) still holds -- all 5 files resolve the name through FormalSystem.Semantics, confirmed by namespace inspection -- but the count is corrected in the plan as a Scope Hypothesis.

plan-file-scope-harvest.sh's generated-surface append stage revealed a gate the research report did not name: check-module-invariants.sh's INV check FAILs on a stale '<!-- BEGIN GENERATED: inventory -->' block, and five such blocks carry line counts for files this task edits (FormalSystem/README.md loose rows for Semantics.lean and the generated root, plus the Presheaf/, PlusLanguage/, OpenLanguage/ and HybridLanguage/ blocks). Plan patched: Phases 1, 4 and 6 each regenerate with 'check-module-invariants.sh --emit-inventory' and verify with '--emit-inventory --check'; Phase 6 also runs typst-sync-check.sh.
